blocks.html: Open vent pipes that extend through a roof shall be terminated not less than 24 inches (610 mm) above the roof. Where a roof is to be used for assembly or as a promenade, observation deck, sun bathing deck or similar purposes, open vent pipes shall terminate not less than 7 feet (2134 mm) above the roof. Approved vandal-resistant vent caps may be used.
